name: Buy In 4
definition: Specifies elements related to the notification (or warn) sent by the central counterparty to the clearing member in the context of the buy in process.

WarningIndicator.name: Warning Indicator
WarningIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the message is a warning only or a notification.

ExpectedBuyInDate.name: Expected Buy In Date
ExpectedBuyInDate.definition: Provides the date at which the buy-in will occur.

CancellationLimitDate.name: Cancellation Limit Date
CancellationLimitDate.definition: Identifies the latest date by which the buy-in operation can be cancelled.

BuyInReversionDate.name: Buy In Reversion Date
BuyInReversionDate.definition: Identifies the date by which the buy-in operation is reversed by the CCP.
